static.description: Server-rendered route with no external client runtime.

basic-island.description: Server-first route with navigation, forms, or small islands.

wasm-island.description: Route that intentionally loads the GoSX WASM island runtime.

scene3d.description: Interactive Scene3D route profiled on a throttled mobile-class browser.

docs-scene3d-ci.description: Documentation route with a Scene3D teaching surface under CI software rasterization. The network limit covers 1610.82 KiB measured in CI run 36273313254 with GPU timing, HDR post color, Sky, and the WebGPU to WebGL fallback. Load and blocking time remain separate gates; shader compilation on software renderers can create long tasks.

water-ci.description: Water route under CI software rasterization. The network limit covers 1846.28 KiB measured in PR #747 CI run 39971086334 after shared renderer-owned instance preparation. This replaces the 1845.26 KiB measurement in PR #727; the shared Scene3D chunk grows while both backend chunks shrink. The limit is the measurement rounded up to the next KiB. Load and blocking time remain separate experience gates. Long-task count is intentionally ungated because continuous software-raster frames straddle the 50ms boundary; real-GPU cadence is certified separately. PR #744 CI run 40027059297 measured 1,892,703 bytes (1848.34 KiB) with no renderer recovery. Of the five loaded framework scripts, only the startup Scene3D script changes from main: +1,757 raw bytes for camera command synchronization, ordered orbit targets and zoom height-floor enforcement. Set the network limit to 1849 KiB, rounding this observed transfer total upward under the existing policy; load and blocking-time limits are unchanged. PR #755 hierarchical spin: hosted exact-source CI run 40186690653 at dbbd76f767ae measured 1,894,176 bytes (1849.78 KiB) without renderer recovery. Parent/loader hooks and native retained transforms add framework delivery bytes; the hierarchy chunk remains demand-loaded. Set only network_kb to 1850 KiB under the existing round-up policy. LCP, TBT, renderer work counts, and production WASM ceilings are unchanged. PR #756 exact-source hosted CI run 40227381059 at 41284b41a465 measured 1,898,180 bytes (1853.69 KiB), without renderer recovery; diagnostic artifact 12612032298 is checksum-verified. Among the five loaded framework scripts, only the Scene3D startup body changes from this PR base (+363 raw bytes); the optional binary command chunk is not loaded by this route. The previous 1850 KiB target predates #742. Set only network_kb to 1854 KiB under the existing measured-total round-up policy. LCP, TBT, renderer and size allowance policies remain unchanged. PR #657 final-source hosted CI run 40440255823 at 8b7b74df3051 measured 1,900,107 bytes (1855.57 KiB) on the clean WebGPU retry, with no renderer recovery, 876 ms LCP and 1025 ms TBT. Diagnostic artifact 12705494731 is retained and checksum-verified. The previous transfer ceiling last accounted for #756 and predates the later renderer/core integrations. Set only water-ci network_kb to 1856 KiB under the existing measured-total round-up policy. LCP, TBT, the shared docs-scene3d-ci profile and all other limits remain unchanged. PR #766 camera TransitionMS easing: hosted CI run 40465368701 at 5a778620c90d measured 1857.07 KiB on the clean WebGPU retry, with no renderer recovery. Among the loaded framework scripts only the Scene3D startup chunk changes (+1,534 raw bytes); the optional command chunk is not loaded by this route. Set only water-ci network_kb to 1858 KiB under the existing measured-total round-up policy. LCP, TBT and all other limits are unchanged. PR #772 decodes each signal batch once on the WASM runtime path: hosted CI run 40666205462 at 41da2bb48375 measured 1859.15 KiB on the retry without renderer recovery. The change adds 275 Brotli bytes to the runtime bootstrap chunk and about 3,900 to the loaded WASM runtime. Set only water-ci network_kb to 1860 KiB under the existing measured-total round-up policy. LCP, TBT and all other limits are unchanged. 2026-10-28: PR #772 third round: hosted CI run 40709787018 at e248a8bd77 measured 1860.21 KiB on the retry without renderer recovery, 0.21 KiB over the 1860 KiB limit. This push adds 293 Brotli bytes (0.29 KiB) to the loaded WASM runtime (TinyGo 0.41.1, wasm-opt version_108: 669217 B for e248a8bd77, 669510 B with the push) and merges main, whose Scene3D tone-mapping change (#768) adds 326 B (0.32 KiB) to the startup Scene3D chunk this route loads (the amount it raised jsWireBytes by), so the expected transfer is about 1860.8 KiB. Set only water-ci network_kb to 1861 KiB under the existing measured-total round-up policy. LCP, TBT and all other limits are unchanged.
